title: Reward prediction error: उम्मीद और नतीजे का फर्क
topic: Reward prediction error in reinforcement-learning models
claim_type: Computational model with animal neurophysiology and human fMRI evidence; subjective-experience claims excluded

events.detail: Manifest और स्थानीय कार्य-निर्देशिका बनाई गई; कोई मीडिया अभी उत्पन्न नहीं।
planned → researched. Source record includes an accessible dopamine RPE review, human high-resolution fMRI evidence and model-scope limits.
researched → verified. Claims are bounded to reward-learning tasks and computational models; dopamine is not equated with pleasure or a direct readout of subjective experience.

verified → scripted. Hindi script distinguishes expected, better-than-expected and worse-than-expected outcomes in a computational learning model; it excludes pleasure-meter and individual-diagnosis claims.

scripted → voiced. A 63.440-second Hindi narration was assembled from two successful short segments after the initial single-pass generation was interrupted; captions use the generated narration readback.
voiced → rendered. Captioned 1080x1920 H.264/AAC final package rendered from disclosed deterministic scenes; pending background image was not used.
rendered → qc_passed. Technical QC passed for file existence, 9:16 geometry, audio stream and 55–65-second duration.
qc_passed → uploaded. Final MP4 and nine required companion records were uploaded to the canonical Drive folder and read back with final-video MD5 checksum.
uploaded → complete. Drive folder and all required artifacts were verified; final metadata and manifest synchronization is the remaining recordkeeping action.
